version_source: sce_sys/pfs-version.dat; sce_sys/param.json is absent from this extraction
validation: Static analysis plus runtime mode-state checks on this exact eboot; visual output and complete RT workload still require validation.
predicate_semantics: Returns (uint64_t(int64_t(current_mode)) - 3) < 3, using unsigned comparison. Performance (2) returns false; modes 3, 4, 5 return true.
render_gate: At 0x137bca5: load current mode; add -6; unsigned compare against -3; jae 0x137bce0. Modes 3..5 enter that branch. Performance falls through, clears [rbx+0x4d1d], and returns via 0x137bcdf.
interpretation: Strong static evidence that the RTGI-related path excludes Performance. Runtime mode reads establish the active mode for the tested sessions, but do not prove the absence of all ray-tracing GPU work.

runtime_validation.patch_site: SELF file offset 0xd1fcc0 replaces the load of saved graphics mode with index 2 before the game derives its mode flags
runtime_validation.performance_state: desired, current, and previous mode were all 2 from 4s through 39s in yotei-performance-input-test; the final patch reproduced mode 2 through 32s in yotei-performance-final
runtime_validation.rt_state: desired, current, and previous mode were all 3 from 4s through 13s in yotei-rt-forced-control
runtime_validation.limits: RT control suffered a Vulkan device loss at 15.1s, while two Performance runs ended normally at 34.1s and 41.6s. This does not establish causation or a controlled FPS improvement. An unpatched run after the first Performance test also selected mode 2, so saved settings can persist across launches.

next_validation: Inspect visual output in Performance mode, verify RT/BVH dispatch differences, and profile comparable later-gameplay frames before claiming a rendering fix or FPS improvement.
